pair.title: Midea LAN
pair.subtitle: Find your Midea air conditioner on the local network.
pair.notice: Homey searches the local network for air conditioners. A SmartHome account is only needed once, for a new V3 air conditioner whose key Homey does not know yet; the password is not stored.
pair.ip_hint: Optional. Leave empty to search the whole local network automatically.
pair.login_hint: Optional. Only for a new V3 air conditioner. The password is not stored.
pair.advanced_label: Advanced: use an existing V3 token and key
pair.advanced_hint: Use this only when you already have both values backed up.
pair.connecting: Searching the local network and verifying the LAN connection…
pair.ready: Leave everything empty and press the button to search.
pair.account_password_required: Enter both the SmartHome account and password.
pair.token_key_required: Enter both the V3 token and key.

repair.title: Repair Midea connection
repair.intro: Update the local IP address and, for V3, obtain a fresh token/key from SmartHome.
repair.hint: Leave SmartHome fields empty when the existing token/key is still valid.

warnings.filter: Clean the air filter of the air conditioner.
